decisions.reason: As a prominently presented 2018 launch in a core formwork line, it carries visible commitment and sunk development effort that make management likely to continue with it unless failure becomes unmistakable.

Although it was only mentioned rather than strongly featured, it survived the early post-launch period and fits the firm's established formwork offering, so management would still tend to retain it and blame weaker results on temporary market factors.
Its own product page signals a clear public commitment and investment in a strategic magnetic formwork component, which under escalation-of-commitment logic supports continued backing.

This product has lower visible commitment than the more prominently marketed launches, but as part of the same magnetic formwork family and still not evidently withdrawn, management would more likely keep than drop it.
